name: Country Ranch Food Products
old_description: At Country Ranch Foods, we pride ourselves on our adaptability and capability to bring to market a wide range of foodservice and institutional foods. Whether it’s crafting savory chilis for a restaurant chain in the southeast United states or producing Chicken Mojo for an exporter on the west coast, we ensure that every product leaving our facility meets the highest standards.
about:
Country Ranch Foods operates from Marietta, Georgia. The company is owned and operated by two Georgia natives, Ed Vanderslice Jr. and Michael Karakos, who have built a business around private-label food production for foodservice and institutional channels. Behind the operation is a dedicated team that chooses to be part of the company’s mission.

The facility manufactures a wide range of products, including savory chilis for restaurant chains in the southeastern United States and Chicken Mojo for exporters on the West Coast. Production is geared toward custom formulations and packaging tailored to each client’s requirements, with the capacity to handle both foodservice and institutional volumes.

The company serves restaurant chains, food exporters, and a network of distribution partners across the food industry. Its client list includes established names in foodservice, though specific brands are not disclosed publicly. The firm positions itself as a dependable partner committed to delivering excellence and reliability.

Country Ranch Foods differentiates itself through adaptability in bringing diverse products to market, a culture centered on integrity, reliability, and food safety, and enduring customer relationships built on trust and proven performance. The facility undergoes regular inspections to maintain compliance with food-safety standards, reinforcing its commitment to quality.
